title: Open-source recipe book
slide_intent: Use editorial space to make ingredients and methods inspectable so a food promise becomes something readers can explore.
strategic_value: A recipe spread can extend Sweetgreen’s identity from a purchase into everyday cooking.
demonstration: An open book on grass shows an ingredient-led spread titled Open-source recipe book, with food photographs and compact text columns.
practical_value: Compare large ingredient imagery with smaller instructional text in a branded editorial format.

content_islands.name: Open spread
content_islands.spec: Retain both pages, including headline, ingredient photographs and text.

content_islands.name: Outdoor surround
content_islands.spec: Keep grass, soil and loose vegetables around the book.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity is demonstrated in a recipe publication spread.
reference_purposes.Expression: Photographed ingredients and an open editorial layout continue the food-focused visual language.
